# Code Savan

> Freelance web designer and full-stack developer based in Abuja, Nigeria, available worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.codesavan.com): Services, experience, client testimonials, FAQs, and contact form.
- [Projects](https://www.codesavan.com/projects): Portfolio of web design and development work.
- [BeautyRX project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/beautyrx): Skincare and wellness website.
- [ZenClean project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/zenclean): House cleaning agency website.
- [Hospitalia project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/hospitalia): Healthcare agency website.
- [GenoLab project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/genolab): Research agency website.
- [Dream IT project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/dreamit): Multi-purpose theme website.
- [Marzive project](https://www.codesavan.com/projects/marzive): Web3 startup website.
